about: The frozen answer key of the golden set: nine answers for each of the 300 articles. Built from the first readers' answers (answers/readers-v1.json) with Anton's corrections folded in. Every station is scored against this file. It does not change silently: the test golden/labels.test.js recomputes the checksum of the answers, so a change has to update the checksum and add a line to 'errata' saying what changed and why.
rules: golden/rules.md: the 27 rules the answers follow; Anton's words per ruling are in golden/verdicts.md
coin_flips: golden/coin-flips.json: answers where two values are accepted; this file carries one of them, either counts as right when scoring
split: golden/split.json: which articles a classifier may be tuned on, and which are held back

check.read: Anton opened the card and marked it checked
check.summary: Anton confirmed the card from a grouped summary without opening it
check.readers: no person looked at it: the answers stand because two blind readers of the full re-read of 3 October gave them (and a third reader where those two differed)
